# design-code

On-demand reference adapted from the vendored MIT UI/UX Kit. Project policy
and frontend-design govern scope and completion.

Use the app's existing framework, styling, and component layer. Qwik and
vanilla-CSS adapters live under ../frameworks/adapters/. Preserve semantics,
state, token intent, keyboard handling, and responsive constraints.
Do not force a new token architecture, icon dependency, animation, or primitive
layer into a small change. Verify the actual route under frontend-design.
Excluded upstream examples and accuracy_report.mjs are not application gates.
